name: fast-jev-compaction-codex
description: Cloudflare-hosted Jev evaluation and verbatim transcript compaction for Codex workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Structured Jev evaluation and safe transcript compaction through Cloudflare
interface.longDescription: Use Cloudflare-hosted Jev for typed workflow judgements and to score tool calls and tool results in a supplied transcript. User and assistant text remains verbatim; stale calls can be removed and stale results can be truncated. The plugin uses existing Wrangler authentication when explicit Cloudflare credentials are absent.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate this state with Jev using typed questions
Compact this transcript while preserving user and assistant text verbatim
Prune stale tool results from this saved conversation safely
